findings.criterion: All options and their scores are saved to localStorage on any change and restored on page reload.
findings.evidence: The app.js file implements loadState() and saveState() using localStorage.setItem('signal_board_options', ...) and localStorage.getItem('signal_board_options'), which are called on initialization and any state changes (adding, scoring, deleting, clearing).

findings.criterion: A 'Clear Board' button is available, which prompts the user for confirmation before wiping the state.
findings.evidence: The index.html contains a button with id 'clear-board-btn'. The app.js file binds a click event listener to this button that triggers a confirm() dialog before clearing the options array and saving the empty state.

findings.criterion: When cleared, the board returns to an informative empty state.
findings.evidence: The index.html contains a div with id 'empty-state' containing informative text. The render() function in app.js toggles the display of this element to 'block' and hides the options grid when the options array is empty.

findings.criterion: All interactive elements (inputs, buttons, scoring controls) are fully keyboard-navigable and focus-visible.
findings.evidence: The styles.css file defines a high-contrast focus-visible outline (*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 2px; }). Interactive elements are standard HTML buttons and inputs, which are natively keyboard-navigable.

findings.criterion: A journey.json file is provided to document the primary user flow, and a README.md explains the application setup.
findings.evidence: Both journey.json and README.md are present in the artifact with complete, non-placeholder content mapping the user flow and explaining the application features.
